title: SM 架构设计
qa_scope: Document transcription, structure, font embedding and sampled rendered-PDF readability only. This is not SM RTL, PTX semantic compliance, synthesis, timing, native NVIDIA bit equivalence, or end-to-end performance validation.

additional_software_checks.appendix_scope: 217 syntax leaves include two control-syntax descriptions; 35 register rows are description groups, not a count of physical registers or all opcode/type forms.

manual_visual_review.coverage: Final post-font-fix PDF: navigation, both equations, SMEM, TMA, Tensor integration/C shift, Fabric, split appendix tables, long mnemonics and special-register names. Not every page was visually inspected.
observations: All 26 navigation entries fit page 2; selected CJK paragraphs and tables are readable without observed clipping or overlaps.
Page 21 shows independent c_scale_shift in the dot adapter and the final round/pack inside MALU; page 22 native equation preserves C scaling.
Pages 40-41 show full dotted mnemonics, section/page identifiers and separate names on native line breaks in monospace, with no observed column spill or Latin-letter stretching.
Pages 47-48 show readable %clock/%clock_hi, timer and reserved-SMEM register names with one name per native line.
Seven source diagrams were separately visually reviewed; all seven final DOCX embedded PNG hashes match the reviewed sources. Diagram counts and physical values are labeled project choices.
manual_visual_review.limitations: This review covers document readability and transcription; technical reviews and the separate 217+35 coverage checker remain separate evidence.
